meta.revisionPolicy: Final on release. Three rulers, never joined: agriculture-year reports (July to June, 2017-18 to 2023-24) and calendar-year estimates for 2023 and 2024, both from the survey's original design, and calendar-year estimates from 2025 on the revamped design (MoSPI redesigned the PLFS sample and estimation from January 2025).
meta.coverage: All India, workers aged 15 and above; percentage distribution by NIC section and the other cuts the calendar-year estimates publish; men, women and all; rural, urban and both; calendar years on the survey's original design
meta.note: PLFS calendar-year estimates from the survey's original design (MoSPI released calendar-year results for 2022, 2023 and 2024 from it), plotted at January. Never joined to the revamped design's calendar years (services-jobs-cy25) or to the agriculture-year reports (services-jobs-ay).
